digest.component_or_area: inbound snapshot pager in rebar_reconciler fetcher
propositions: _iter_pages terminates on a short page and advances by the requested page_size, so a server-truncated first page silently ends the scan and drops most issues from the inbound snapshot.
Jira Data Center silently caps maxResults below the requested page_size, making a truncated page read as the end of results and causing 92% of issues (230 of 250) to be lost.
Lost issues are never seen by the reconciler pass, causing bound issues to be treated as deleted and unbound issues to fail reconciliation while the run falsely reports converged success.
The fix advances by len(page) and terminates only on an empty page, mirroring the earlier get_parent_map correction, and must be verified safe for the shared Cloud path as well as Data Center.
An offset-stall guard must raise SilentTruncationError rather than loop forever when a server ignores startAt and returns the same non-empty page repeatedly.
Existing cap, ACLI ceiling, and same-token-twice cursor-stall behaviors must remain unchanged after the fix.
